title: A throttled source read waits for Retry-After, then the block appears
expectedText: The source answers a read with 429 and Retry-After 120. For the next 110 seconds the tool makes no call to the source and the target stays free. Within two minutes after that the target is busy.
localLimit: Both directions raise the read error of one calendar system. The error path of the other system stays unchecked.
